newsitem.title: UK: Romania c.bank head sees 1998 inflation falling.
newsitem.headline: Romania c.bank head sees 1998 inflation falling.

text.p: Romanian National Bank governor Mugur Isarescu said on Thursday that he hoped year-on-year inflation in Romania would fall to 20 to 25 percent in 1998 from about 120 percent this year. "In 1998 (inflation) will be lower, perhaps an ambitious target of 20 to 25 percent," Isarescu said at an investor presentation in London.

Speaking ahead of the launch of Romania's first mark-denominated Eurobond, Isarescu said the target could be met provided there was implementation of a tough reform programme, including privatisation, economic restructuring and tight monetary and fiscal policies.
Romania's new centrist coalition government, which ousted ex-communists in elections last November, has embarked on a shock-therapy programme to reshape the economy and gain international support.
